name: How long does it take to buy a distressed property?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to buy a distressed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for buying a distressed property can vary significantly compared to a traditional sale. Short sales typically take the longest, often several months, as they require lender approval for the sale price. Foreclosures and bank-owned properties may close more quickly, but still often exceed standard transaction periods due to administrative processes. Setting realistic expectations regarding closing times is a key part of the process that our team helps clients manage across the South Florida region.
acceptedAnswer.description: The timeline varies; short sales can take months due to lender approval, while foreclosures and REO properties may close faster but often exceed standard transaction times.
